item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to bring generally fine and rather cool weather to the coast of southern China in the next few days. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon and broad band of clouds, the weather will be cloudier and it will become cold over Guangdong in the middle and latter part of next week.

Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly fine and very dry.
Temp range: 14 - 19 C
R.H. range: 35 - 60 per Cent
PSR: Low
